thread:
sarah: Quick sync — proposal: run quantized model binaries in a shadow-canary against a float reference. Keep sampled traffic tiny (1-2%) and add a microbench on replayed golden inputs before full admit. want opinions on tradeoffs.

mike: +1. what's the target sample size? worried about false negatives on corner prompts.

sarah: thinking stratified sampling: 0.5% long-tail (seqlen>1024), 0.5% high-entropy prompts, rest random. microbench runs on a small golden set replay.

jun: sounds reasonable. one concern: kv-cache interactions — quantized execution can change cache behavior. we should capture prefix-reuse and cache-hit divergence.

alexa: also watch token alignment and log-prob deltas. we can reuse the eval harness but need a lightweight runner that doesn't blow up infra.

sarah: exactly. proposal adds two checks: (1) mini-lint: tokenization parity + decoding checksum, (2) microbench: ~100 golden inputs across seqlens measuring latency tail and token-delta stats.

mike: what about cost? running both models on shadow doubles token cost for sampled traffic.

sarah: keep sample tiny + schedule microbench off-peak + run quantized on a low-priority pool. rough estimate +1-2% overall cost.

benchbot: microbench job queued: job-id 7729. results -> /bench/results/7729.csv

jun: can we gate rollout on metric thresholds? e.g. token-delta fraction > 0.02, perplexity delta, 95p latency increase < 1.2x, alignment score >= 0.98.

alexa: add an automated fallback: if drift detected within first 24h, auto-reroute sampled traffic to float, open incident in #eng-oncall, and create a ticket.

sarah: agree. i'll draft an rfc addendum describing a 'shadow-prober' interface + config for sampling, thresholds, and fallback policies. pinging @opsbot for infra/cost estimate.

opsbot: logged request INF-1312 for infra/cost estimate, ETA 24h.

mike: one more: ensure kv-cache warming is reproducible in microbench (use seeded replay) — otherwise the noise will mask small regressions.

sarah: noted. i'll include a reproducible seeder and a prereq checklist in the addendum. thx y'all :thumbsup:
